title: Exactness of extension by zero
statement:
Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring. Let $j:U\hookrightarrow\overline X$ be
an open immersion [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties] of schemes and use
the small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] with the
constant coefficient sheaf $A$, including the finite-torsion coefficient
rings [def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility] $A_{E,n}$. Then the
extension-by-zero functor [def-weil-extension-by-zero] $j_!$ is exact.

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-proetale-weakly-etale-localization] to the open immersion $j:U\hookrightarrow\overline X$ and the commutative ring $A$. It identifies $U_{\mathrm{proet}}$ with $\overline X_{\mathrm{proet}}/U$, including their coverings, and identifies $A_U$ with $A_{\overline X}|_U$. Thus the source module category is the category of $A_{\overline X}|_U$-module sheaves on this localized site. Moreover every ambient object has at most one map to $U$, and such a map exists exactly when it factors through $U$.

source.place: Localization and coefficient identifications used in the definition; made explicit by lem-weil-proetale-weakly-etale-localization.

proof.text: Apply [lem-pur-site-restriction-module-adjunction-exact] with $\mathcal C=\overline X_{\mathrm{proet}}$, $\mathcal O=A_{\overline X}$ and the object $U$. Its extension-by-zero presheaf [def-weil-extension-by-zero-presheaf] has, on $V$, a direct sum indexed by maps $V\to U$. By Step 1 this is the zero module if no map exists, and otherwise the single module $M(V\to U)$; its action and restriction maps are precisely those of [def-weil-extension-by-zero]. Its module sheafification is therefore the functor $j_!$ in the statement. The cited theorem says this functor is exact. This applies to every finite commutative $A$ in the statement, hence also to each stated finite-torsion coefficient ring.
